## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py carchoice` refreshes this map.

## Data tables (`anvil.yaml` db_schema)

- **app_settings**: key:str, value:obj · used in common
- **brands**: name:str, country:str, group_name:str, founded:num, website:str, warranty:num, pt_warranty:num, notes:str · used in Admin, Cars, Importer, Seed
- **car_fields**: key:str, label:str, grp:str, kind:str, unit:str, decimals:num, filter:bool, show:bool, sort:num, help:str, better:str · used in Admin, CarAdmin, Cars, Importer, Seed
- **cars**: make:str, model:str, slug:str, specs:obj, notes:str, source:str, import_ref→imports, status:str, created:dt, updated:dt · used in Admin, CarAdmin, Cars, DemoData, Importer, Listings, Seed, Shortlist
- **feedback**: user→users, name:str, email:str, kind:str, message:str, context:obj, status:str, note:str, created:dt · used in Feedback
- **imports**: who→users, created:dt, filename:str, kind:str, source:str, added:num, updated:num, notes:str, status:str · used in Admin, CarAdmin, Importer
- **listings**: user→users, car→cars, url:str, title:str, price:num, currency:str, km:num, year:num, location:str, seller:str, notes:str, status:str, created:dt, updated:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, CarAdmin, Listings
- **marketplaces**: name:str, region:str, kind:str, url:str, search_url:str, notes:str, sort:num, active:bool · used in Markets, Seed
- **picks**: user→users, car→cars, rank:num, note:str, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, CarAdmin, Cars, DemoData, Listings, Shortlist
- **searches**: user→users, name:str, filters:obj, summary:str, count:num, created:dt, updated:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, Searches
- **sources**: title:str, kind:str, publisher:str, year:num, url:str, status:str, notes:str, created:dt · used in Admin, CarAdmin, Seed
- **users**: email:str, enabled:bool, last_login:dt, password_hash:str, n_password_failures:num, confirmed_email:bool, signed_up:dt, display_name:str, is_admin:bool, is_demo:bool, last_seen:dt, legal_version:str, legal_accepted_at:dt, legal_source:str, remembered_logins:obj, prefs:obj · used in Admin, DemoData

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
